normative_basis.c2_status: valid HGW theoretical base case, not the selected HSL26 artifact kernel

boundary_regularities.c2: derivatives through order 3 vanish; fourth derivative is the first boundary discontinuity
boundary_regularities.c4: derivatives through order 5 vanish; fifth derivative is the first boundary discontinuity

mathematical_comparison.important_correction: The claim that C2 has a third-derivative jump is false for this profile.

interpretation: C4 is selected because the final technical specification fixes its identifier and polynomial.
C4 provides higher boundary regularity and is compatible with future higher-order HGW operators.
The current registrar uses value/gradient and mixed second-order covariance blocks; it does not directly require a third derivative.
No claim of guaranteed 3-to-5 iteration convergence is made without a calibrated held-out dataset.
